_comment: Outlook overlay colour -> coordinator_id, for the month-view PDF ingester.
The PDF export carries no legend, so this cannot be derived from the file
and must be filled in by looking at the Outlook calendar list once. The
colours are stable per Outlook profile.
'navy' is already resolved by evidence, not by guessing: 14 of 14 titled
events in the August 2026 export are navy and 0 of 175 non-navy entries
carry a title, and only the export owner's own calendar renders titles.
Leave a hue null rather than guessing. An unattributed entry is logged as
unattributed; a wrongly attributed one silently moves another person's load.
